title: Integrality of the product of an integer multiplicity current with [[0,1]] (parent B5)
statement: Assume (VO) for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 (the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support), (MR) for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W (the frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure) and (IMC) the conjunction of (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, Hⁿ-a.e. on M the approximate tangent spaces of M and M' coincide; (b) for U open, an IMRep R and a Borel set E, (R.carrier ∩ E, R.mult, R.orient) is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier of an IMRep R. Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) and Jv := ι(0, v). Then for all N, k ∈ ℕ, integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and C ∈ 𝒟_{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}): if for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is a family η : ℝ → 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v_1, …, v_{k+1}) = ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) for all t, x, v and C(ω) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt, then C is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1), ∃ η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1 + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ C ω = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (η t)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C
